notice: One paid plan has a launch price to be tested: coffre-horodate, 19 EUR excl. VAT per month per firm (price_status to_test, not final). Every other amount, quota and fee is a placeholder (TBD); none is invented. Billing is not live yet: no payment is collected until the dedicated XVcache Stripe account exists. Local V/X (verify_journal) is free. Certified proofs (qualified eIDAS timestamps via Certigna, plus OpenTimestamps) are the paid feature.
